Reference / crypto/hmac

crypto/hmac#

HMAC (RFC 2104) with an explicit hash.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let tag = Hmac(HmacHash.sha256, key, message).bytes();
Hmac(HmacHash.sha256, key, message).matches(tag); // true

Description#

HMAC (RFC 2104) with an explicit hash. The key is a SecretBytes capability exported once to the host at construction; any length is accepted (longer than the block size is hashed, as the RFC specifies). Hmac is a Digesting over the message: successors append, bytes() is the raw tag. matches() compares a supplied tag in constant time; never compare tags with ==.
